description_expanded: Now known as Grayt Haven —formerly Sea Prize—this beautifully reimagined four-level retreat captures the laid-back charm of Grayton Beach with elevated coastal style and thoughtful gathering spaces throughout. With 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and accommodations for up to 16 guests, the home is perfectly suited for large families and group getaways. Just a 1-minute walk to beach access with no road to cross, guests can move effortlessly from the sugar-white sand to the home’s private pool while enjoying Gulf views from multiple balconies and outdoor living spaces above. Inside, the home feels bright, polished, and welcoming, blending airy interiors with warm wood flooring, coastal textures, and abundant natural light. The main living level was designed for connection, featuring an open-concept layout where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow seamlessly together beneath soaring ceilings and expansive windows. The spacious kitchen is beautifully appointed with stainless steel appliances, generous prep space, and seating that easily accommodates the entire group for everything from slow breakfasts to celebratory dinners after a day on the beach. Comfortable living spaces invite guests to settle in for movie nights, cocktails, or quiet mornings with coffee overlooking the neighborhood palms and glimpses of the Gulf beyond. A King Suite is conveniently located on the main living level, offering a peaceful retreat close to the heart of the home. Upstairs, additional guest accommodations include a second King suite, two oversized guest rooms with two Queen beds each, and a cheerful guest room featuring a Queen bed with a Twin bunk—an ideal setup for younger guests or a family traveling together. Multiple en-suite and hall baths provide added convenience for larger groups. On the top level, a bonus den with a wet bar opens to elevated outdoor space where Gulf breezes and sunset skies create an inviting backdrop for evening gatherings or relaxed afternoons away from the crowd. Outdoors, Grayt Haven truly shines as a private coastal escape. The sparkling private pool is surrounded by ample lounging space for soaking up the Florida sunshine, while covered balconies and porches provide shaded spots to unwind throughout the day. A propane grill makes casual poolside cookouts easy, and the outdoor shower offers a convenient rinse after long beach days. Whether you’re enjoying dinner under the palms, relaxing with a book on the balcony, or cooling off after an afternoon in the Gulf, every outdoor space was designed to enhance the coastal experience. Located in the heart of Grayton Beach, Grayt Haven places guests within a short walk of some of 30A’s most beloved local favorites. Spend an evening at the iconic Red Bar, enjoy fresh coastal fare and Gulf views at Chiringo, or browse local boutiques and beachside shops nearby. Grayton Beach State Park is only minutes away, offering scenic nature trails, rare coastal dune lakes, kayaking, paddleboarding, and one of the most beautiful stretches of shoreline along the Gulf. Beyond Grayton, neighboring communities like Seaside and WaterColor offer additional dining, shopping, and entertainment just a short bike ride or drive away. Whether your days are filled with beach adventures, live music, paddleboarding, or sunset dinners by the water, Grayt Haven offers a stunning home base for an unforgettable 30A getaway. First Floor: Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Second Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo. Third Floor: King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Walk-In Shower, Queen Room with Twin Bunk, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo. Fourth Floor: Bonus Den with Wet Bar. Pool heat available October–April for an additional $50.00 per day.
